verdict.rationale: Training-data use is a fair privacy question for a hosted email service that stores user messages, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a no-training policy, an opt-out control, or any statement about how AgentMail uses customer data for model training. SOC 2 Type II compliance, pod isolation, and the community-mentioned Bring Your Own Cloud option are adjacent security and deployment features, not a training-data control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
